recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid white (#FFFFFF).
2. Place the title text box in the top band of the slide (~5-15% height), horizontally centered, containing 'Effect of small and large Learning Rate' in bold red (#FF0000) sans-serif, the largest text on the slide.
3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle in the top-right corner, diameter slightly larger than its text, with black (#000000) sans-serif '28' centered inside.
4. Draw a thin dark-blue (#1F4E79) rectangle outline with no fill enclosing both chart panels and their headings, just outside the panels' combined footprint (together the panels span ~5-95% of slide width and ~20-70% of slide height).
5. Place the left panel heading 'Small Learning Rate' in bold black (#000000) sans-serif at the top of the left panel (panel area ~5-48% width, ~20-70% height), centered over that panel, smaller than the title.
6. Draw the left panel y-axis: a red (#FF0000) vertical arrow pointing up along the panel's left edge, labeled 'Loss' in regular black (#000000) text beside the arrow.
7. Draw the left panel x-axis: a red (#FF0000) horizontal arrow pointing right along the panel's bottom, labeled 'Value of weight' in regular black (#000000) text below the axis.
8. Draw the left panel loss curve: a smooth blue (#2E75B6) U-shaped (parabolic) line opening upward, minimum near the panel's horizontal center just above the x-axis.
9. Add the left panel descent path: 6 small blue (#2E75B6) dots on the left descending arm of the parabola joined by short straight blue line segments stepping downward toward the minimum, plus a tiny black (#000000) arrow near the bottom of the path pointing at the valley minimum.
10. Place the right panel heading 'Large Learning Rate' in bold black (#000000) sans-serif at the top of the right panel (panel area ~52-95% width, ~20-70% height), centered over that panel, same size as the left heading.
11. Draw the right panel y-axis: a red (#FF0000) vertical arrow pointing up along the panel's left edge, labeled 'Loss' in regular black (#000000) text.
12. Draw the right panel x-axis: a red (#FF0000) horizontal arrow pointing right along the panel's bottom, labeled 'Value of weight' in regular black (#000000) text.
13. Draw the right panel loss curve: a smooth blue (#2E75B6) U-shaped (parabolic) line identical in shape to the left panel's curve.
14. Add the right panel oscillation path: 4 larger blue (#2E75B6) dots connected by long straight blue line segments zigzagging across the valley, dot 1 high on the left arm, dot 2 high on the right arm, dot 3 lower on the left arm, dot 4 higher on the right arm, illustrating overshooting of the minimum.
15. Verify the finished slide: white background; red bold centered title at top; yellow circle with black '28' at top-right; thin dark-blue frame around both panels; both headings bold black; all axis labels regular black; curves and step paths blue; static slide with every element fully visible.
